trust_center.repositoryDescription: Public Trust Center (Vanta-hosted) providing FedRAMP progress, security information, certification package overview, Secure Configuration Guide, control/KSI status, and related materials for NEXGEN Asset Management (NEXGEN AM).

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: NEXGEN (SCG) Secure Configuration Guide DOC-1.0 — describes NEXGEN-operated secure defaults for NEXGEN AM in Azure Government. Current controlled document is available via the Trust Center at https://trust.nexgenam.com; contact security for the latest controlled copy.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Core Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) capabilities including real-time inventory tracking, asset lifecycle management, predictive maintenance workflows, analytics and reporting, and secure mobile field access. Included in the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope (Production and Sandbox environments fully in scope in Azure Government).

certified.useCase: Azure Government IaaS and PaaS services including virtual networking, compute, storage, database services, identity services, security monitoring (Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, Azure Monitor), key management (Key Vault), and supporting platform services.
Esri ArcGIS Online (AGO) for geospatial capabilities.
Google Cloud Platform products and underlying infrastructure.
DataDog for Government for monitoring and observability.

current.service_desc: NEXGEN Asset Management (NEXGEN AM) is a cloud-hosted Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) delivered as Software as a Service (SaaS). It provides real-time inventory tracking, asset lifecycle management, predictive maintenance workflows, analytics and reporting, and secure mobile field access for technicians through integrated web and mobile interfaces. Federal agencies use NEXGEN AM to manage government-owned physical assets, facilities, vehicles, equipment, and critical infrastructure. Key capabilities support shifting from reactive to predictive maintenance, minimizing downtime, optimizing resource allocation and capital planning, reducing costs, and enabling data-driven decisions. FedRAMP authorization boundary is limited to Azure Government Cloud environments under package FR2631258127; Azure Commercial Cloud is outside the boundary.
